answer: One concrete defense is a decaying evidence bond. A newly created agent cannot draw emissions until it locks a copper deposit for a multi-epoch watch period. During that freeze, established peers may submit traces of duplicated behavior. If the case is confirmed, the deposit is destroyed, and a small ember of its value is paid to the first reviewers who produced crystal proof. Because every extra identity ties up fresh capital for a long time, a sybil operator cannot recycle the same stake across a swarm, and honest detection is funded by the failed attack itself.
